facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹5.39 lakh cr, +7% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹94,023 cr, +12% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹1.41 lakh cr (+10% YoY), PAT ₹26,218 cr (+20% YoY).
Revenue has compounded at 9% over 10 years, 13% over 5 and 14% over 3; the last twelve months (+7%) are running behind the 3-year pace.
Profit and revenue have compounded at a similar pace over 3 years (14% vs 14%).
Deposits stand at ₹63.47 lakh cr, +5% since Mar 2026.
Assets are 12.9× shareholders' equity (₹6.72 lakh cr); leverage is the business model for a lender, so watch asset quality rather than debt.
Gross NPA is 2.13% and net NPA 0.52% at the latest reported quarter.
Promoters hold 55.5%, unchanged over a year.
Operating cash flow is not a useful quality test for a lender — deposits and loans flow through it. Judge earnings quality on asset quality and provisioning instead.
